headlines.description: Matt Hasselbeck and Andre Johnson showed Thursday night that sometimes old guys can shine in what is certainly a young man's league, leading the Colts to a 27-20 win over the Texans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts' Johnson (2 TDs) leads way against Texans

headlines.description: Robert Alford returned an interception 59 yards for a touchdown, lifting the undefeated Atlanta Falcons to a 25-19 win over the Washington Redskins in overtime Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alford's INT return lifts Falcons past Redskins 25-19 in OT

headlines.description: Andy Dalton led the Bengals from a 17-point fourth-quarter deficit to a 27-24 overtime victory on Sunday over the Seattle Seahawks, keeping Cincinnati undefeated with the second-biggest comeback
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton rallies Bengals over Seahawks 27-24 in overtime

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for two touchdowns and 241 yards, and the Green Bay Packers held off the St. Louis Rams for a 24-10 win on Sunday in spite of three turnovers by their normally mistake-free qu
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers' defense backs Rodgers in 24-10 win over Rams

headlines.description: Tyrod Taylor threw a touchdown pass, ran for another and even caught a pass in rallying the Buffalo Bills to a 14-13 win over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rally from 10-point deficit, beat Titans 14-13

events.name: Chicago Bears at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jay Cutler led Chicago to a pair of fourth-quarter touchdowns, including an alert toss to running back Matt Forte with 18 seconds left, giving the Bears a stunning 18-17 victory over the Kansas C
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears rally in fourth quarter to Beat Chiefs 18-17

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Sam Bradford overcame two red-zone interceptions and threw for 333 yards and two touchdowns, Fletcher Cox forced two fumbles on sacks and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the New Orleans Saints 39-17
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford, Cox lead Eagles to 39-17 win over Saints

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Doug Martin ran for 123 yards and scored three touchdowns Sunday, helping Jameis Winston rebound from his worst pro performance and lead the Buccaneers to a 38-31 victory over the mistake-prone J
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs beat Jaguars, end 11-game home losing streak

headlines.description: Travis Coons kicked a 32-yard field goal in overtime and Josh McCown threw for a team-record 457 yards to lead the Cleveland Browns to a stunning 33-30 victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday
headlines.shortLinkText: Coons' FG in OT gives Browns 33-30 win over Ravens

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw for three touchdowns, Matthew Stafford was benched after throwing a third interception, and the Arizona Cardinals routed the Detroit Lions 42-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer throws 3 TDs to help Cardinals dominate Lions 42-17

events.name: New England Patriots at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for two touchdowns, with a 1-yard plunge for another score, and the New England Patriots pulled away from a powerless Dallas offense missing Tony Romo and Dez Bryant for a 30-6 vi
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots pull away from Romo-less Cowboys 30-6

headlines.description: Chris Harris Jr. returned a fourth-quarter interception 74 yards for a touchdown and the Denver Broncos overcame a shaky day from Peyton Manning to beat the Oakland Raiders 16-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris' INT return leads Broncos to 16-10 win over Raiders

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Larry Donnell's spectacular catch over two 49ers with 21 seconds remaining lifted the New York Giants past San Francisco 30-27 on Sunday night, capping Eli Manning's sensational performance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli logs another final-drive win to sink 49ers

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Le'Veon Bell scored on a 1-yard wildcat run as time expired to give Mike Vick and the Pittsburgh Steelers a stunning 24-20 victory over the San Diego Chargers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell TD as time expires lifts Pittsburgh in S.D.
